title: XRootD xrdmoncollect
description: Operational and transfer-activity metrics exposed by xrdmoncollect (--metrics-port).

panels.title: Packets/s
panels.description: Monitor UDP packets ingested per second.

panels.title: Documents/s
panels.description: Terminal documents produced per second.

panels.title: Malformed/s
panels.description: Undecodable packets per second (should be ~0).

panels.title: Orphan closes/s
panels.description: Closes with no matching open (lost-open indicator).

panels.title: Correlation state
panels.description: Resident bytes held in correlation dictionaries.

panels.title: Recv queue
panels.description: Packet batches waiting for the serializer (backpressure).

panels.title: Ingest rate
panels.description: Receive-loop throughput and quality signals.

panels.title: Records decoded by stream
panels.description: Per-stream decode rate from the detailed monitoring feed.

panels.title: Correlation state (bytes)
panels.description: Memory held by correlation dictionaries; bounded by --max-memory.

panels.title: Evictions & reaps
panels.description: State turnover from the memory budget and server TTL.

panels.title: Receive queue depth
panels.description: Sustained non-zero => the serializer is not keeping up.

panels.title: Sink POST failures/s
panels.description: POSTs that failed after retries (per sink).

panels.title: Dropped bodies/s
panels.description: Bodies discarded after a failed POST with no/failed cache.

panels.title: Sink queue depth
panels.description: Bodies queued to the output thread (backlog to the sink).

panels.title: Disk cache backlog (files)
panels.description: On-failure cache depth; drains when the sink recovers.

panels.title: Cache stored vs replayed/s
panels.description: Store rate rises during an outage; replay rate during recovery.

panels.title: Transfers & accesses/s
panels.description: Completed whole-file transfers and partial-access closes.

panels.title: Read / write throughput
panels.description: Byte throughput aggregated from close records.

panels.title: Active transfers
panels.description: Files currently open per server (gauge).

panels.title: Failed operations/s by category
panels.description: Unsuccessful operations grouped by error category.

panels.title: Transfer duration (s)
panels.description: Wall-clock transfer duration quantiles (from the histogram).

panels.title: Transfer size (bytes)
panels.description: Bytes moved per transfer (from the histogram).

panels.title: Locality (local vs remote)/s
panels.description: Completed transfers split by client/server locality.

panels.title: Sessions ended/s
panels.description: Client sessions concluded (requires --sessions).

panels.title: Redirects/s by kind
panels.description: Client redirects issued (local vs remote target).

panels.title: Third-party copies/s
panels.description: Completed TPC jobs by direction and result.

panels.title: TPC throughput
panels.description: Third-party-copy byte throughput.

panels.title: HTTP requests/s
panels.description: HTTP activity by method and status code.

panels.title: OSS ops/s (with slow)
panels.description: Storage-system operations; slow-op series overlaid.

panels.title: Proxy cache (PFC)
panels.description: Proxy-file-cache closes and bytes by source (hit/miss/...).

panels.title: Throttle plugin
panels.description: Throttle-plugin I/O rate and in-flight count.

panels.title: FRM stage / purge
panels.description: File-residency-manager stage/purge activity.

panels.title: Estimated lost packets/s
panels.description: Packet-sequence gaps per server (UDP loss).
